# OneKash Labs

> OneKash Labs makes private, open-source apps: no ads, no tracking, nothing collected. It also helps people learn to build their own app, customize an open-source app (where its license allows), and run its apps for a team.

Website: https://onekash.org
Source code: https://github.com/OneKashLabs
Contact: the Contact us button on https://onekash.org

## What OneKash Labs offers

### Learn to build your own app
A bootcamp that goes from the first screen to publishing in an app store. The waitlist is open; join it through Contact us on onekash.org.

### An open-source app, with your name on it
OneKash Labs customizes an open-source app, its own or another project's, with your name, colours, and features. Each project starts by checking the app's license: what it allows decides what can be renamed, changed, and shipped.

### Our apps for your team
You bring the team; OneKash Labs brings the apps and the know-how to set them up and use them.

## Apps

Every app is open source, has no ads, and collects nothing.

### KashCal
All your calendars in one private app on Android.
- Syncs iCloud calendars directly, and CalDAV servers such as Nextcloud, Radicale, Baïkal, and Stalwart.
- Shows and edits the phone's own calendars alongside the rest.
- Subscribes to ICS calendars: holidays, school schedules, sports seasons.
- Two-way CardDAV contact sync, including photos.
- Builds birthday and anniversary calendars from your contacts.
- Works fully offline without any account.
- Encrypted credentials, HTTPS by default, no WebViews.
Website: https://kashcal.onekash.org
Get it: Google Play, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, or GitHub Releases (https://github.com/KashCal/KashCal/releases).

### KashPass
An Android companion for KeePass vaults, with no internet permission.
- Opens KDBX 4.0 and 4.1 vaults with a password, a key file, or both (AES-256 or ChaCha20; AES-KDF, Argon2d, or Argon2id).
- Opens the vault file from any storage app through Android's file picker, and saves back to the same file.
- Search across titles, user names, URLs, notes, tags, and custom fields; passwords are never searched.
- Adds, edits, and deletes entries the way KeePass 2 does, with entry history and the recycle bin.
- Fingerprint or face unlock; locks when the screen turns off.
- Checks the file before each save and reads it back after, so a failed save keeps your edits.
Website: https://kashpass.onekash.org
Get it: https://github.com/OneKashLabs/KashPass/releases

### KashCake
Never forget a Cake Day. Birthday and anniversary reminders from your contacts on Android, with no internet access.
- Reads birthdays and anniversaries from your contacts and keeps them current, even while closed.
- Reminders on the day, or any day up to 30 before, at any time.
- Ages and milestones; wishes by message, email, or share; search; and a home-screen widget.
- Read only: never changes your contacts. No account, ads, or analytics.
Website: https://kashcake.onekash.org
Get it: the Google Play beta (https://kashcake.onekash.org/beta/) or GitHub Releases (https://github.com/OneKashLabs/KashCake/releases).

### iCloud Calendar MCP
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI agents read and write access to iCloud Calendar over CalDAV.
- Runs anywhere a JVM runs; no Mac needed.
- Durable event handles across sessions, correct handling of recurring events, bounded responses.
- Security aligned with the OWASP MCP Top 10. Uses an app-specific password, never the main account password.
- Published on the MCP Registry, npm, and PyPI.
Website: https://mcp.onekash.org
Source: https://github.com/icloud-calendar-mcp/icloud-calendar-mcp

### devloop
A test-driven development loop for Claude Code and Codex, shipped as a plugin of markdown skills and agents.
- /spec clarifies what to build, /plan decides how, /implement builds it test first.
- Independent agents review the plan and the code in a context that did not write them; you approve at two checkpoints.
- Free and open source, Apache-2.0, no runtime dependencies.
Website: https://devloop.onekash.org
Source: https://github.com/OneKashLabs/devloop

## More detail on each app

Each app's site has its own llms.txt and llms-full.txt: https://kashcal.onekash.org, https://kashpass.onekash.org, https://kashcake.onekash.org, and https://mcp.onekash.org (add /llms.txt or /llms-full.txt). devloop has https://devloop.onekash.org/llms.txt.
